name: io.neobrix.singularity_sdk_android.SingularityLoginActivity
description: CoinBrix's Singularity SDK shows its account page inside the app when the app starts Singularity sign-in or receives an account sign-in link. Users sign in there, and returned account credentials are passed back to the SDK.
disableEffect: The app cannot complete Singularity sign-in or process its account sign-in return.
